{{quote|Did [[Mosk the Giant|Mosk]] and Merk really fight with spears of fire, and were they even giants?|Thom Merrilin{{ref/book|4|20}}}}

'''Merk the Giant''' is a character in one of the ancient [[stories]] in [[Thom Merrilin|Thom Merrilin's]] repertoire.  The story of Merk the Giant dates to the [[First Age]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Merk|Merk}}  Merk fought against Mosk, another giant, who had a "Lance of fire that could reach around the world."{{ref/book|1|4}}  Merk used "spears of fire" to fight against Mosk.{{ref||Merk}}  The story of Mosk and Merk is an example of a historical account that over time evolved into a legend which further changed and faded into a myth.  This is common for all stories that transcend multiple ages as the [[Wheel of Time]] turns.{{ref/book|1|1}}  Eventually the myth of Merk the Giant will disappear from memory and will be long forgotten when the age that gave rise to the original story comes again.{{ref/book|1|1}}

==Parallels==
Merk is a hidden reference to the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States of America]] and Mosk refers to [[Wikipedia:Moscow|Moscow]], America's opponent during the Cold War of the 20th Century. Their spears and lances of fire are hidden references to combat waged via the use of [[Wikipedia:Intercontinental ballistic missile|intercontinental ballistic missiles]].
